- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Green Works' laundry detergents are biodegradable and non-toxic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Branch Basics offers a natural, non-toxic, and biodegradable laundry detergent with a refill option.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Certifications to look for when shopping for eco-friendly laundry detergent include EPA Safer Choice, Leaping Bunny Program, and Biodegradable certifications.
- [PREFERENCE] User expresses interest in Seventh Generation and Ecover options and asks for more information on pricing, availability, refill options, and subscription services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Seventh Generation laundry detergent prices range from $5-$8 for a 40-load bottle and $15-$20 for a 100-load bottle.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Seventh Generation products are available at major retailers like Amazon, Walmart, Target, Whole Foods, and their website.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Seventh Generation offers a Concentrated Refill Pouch made from 80% post-consumer recycled material.
